about_the_game:
🕹️ About this Demo:

In this demo of Natural Unintelligence: Zueirama 2, you’ll get to play the beginning of the game and experience the core mechanics — including pizza delivery on a motorcycle and roguelike combat against the AI’s robot army. You’ll also experience the essence of a world full of humor, quirky characters, and the kind of chaotic fun inspired by internet culture and memes.

This is a work-in-progress version and does not represent the final quality of the game. However, it gives you a clear idea of the fun, creativity, and unpredictable adventures waiting for you in the full version of Natural Unintelligence: Zueirama 2.

Natural Unintelligence: Zueirama 2

🎮 What’s included in this Demo:

  • 🚩 Available modes: Pizza delivery and roguelike combat against robots.

  • 🚩 Estimated playtime: Between 30 and 90 minutes, depending on your playstyle.

  • 🚩 Players: Single player only.

  • 🚩 Languages available in the demo: Brazilian Portuguese, English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Turkish.

  • 🚩 Additional content like platforming levels, full troll mode, more phases, and extra minigames will be available in the full game.[/p][/*][/list]

    Battle the Robots in Roguelike Mayhem

    No two runs are ever the same! Face random enemies, chaotic rooms, and different challenges each time you play. The AI despises fun, and you are the wet resistance — armed with a water tank and some highly questionable life decisions. Splash, bash, and dash!

    Deliver Pizzas to Make Money

    Make money delivering pizzas while popping wheelies! Unlock bizarre bikes and spread chaos on the streets. The more trolling you do, the more cash you earn — and more money means even more trolling!

    Insane Minigames!

    Enjoy a collection of crazy minigames that test your reflexes, rhythm, logic (or lack thereof), and even your meme knowledge. Each minigame brings new surprises and plenty of laughs.

short_description: A rogue AI threatens the world. Your weapons? Pizza, pranks, and pure stupidity. Desinteligência Natural blends roguelike robot fights, goofy deliveries, and NPC trolling into one big, dumb, hilarious adventure. Embrace the chaos!
supported_languages:
English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese*, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
